---
title: Stuffed Olives
id: MAR-0051
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 10
time_min: 80
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 0.5 kg large green olives
- 120 g ground beef
- 30 g chicken livers
- 20 g breadcrumbs
- 40 g grated Grana Padano cheese
- 1 whole egg + 1 egg yolk
- 1 dl white wine
- 0.5 onion
- 0.5 teaspoon lemon zest
- 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- to taste flour
- to taste nutmeg
- to taste breadcrumbs
- to taste frying oil
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Sauté the chopped onion in the oil for 3 minutes, add the meat with the chicken livers cut into pieces.
2. After 5 minutes, moisten with the wine, let it evaporate and continue cooking for about 10 minutes, stirring often.
3. Put in the mixer the meat, the egg yolk, the Grana, the breadcrumbs, a pinch of nutmeg, the lemon zest and salt.
4. Pit the olives with the appropriate tool and fill them with the mixture obtained, possibly using a pastry bag with a small hole tip.
5. Dredge the olives in flour, beaten egg and then in breadcrumbs.
6. Then fry them in hot oil, turning them.
7. Drain them with the appropriate spatula and place them on kitchen paper towels.
